groups.title: Quran text and translation
groups.description: The Arabic Quran and an English translation of its meaning are not the same thing, so Revert Guide labels which one you are reading.

groups.title: Hadith references
groups.description: A hadith citation here keeps the collection name, the number, and the grading where one exists.

groups.title: New Muslim education
groups.description: Beginner material explains how things work in practice. It does not give you a personalized ruling.

groups.title: Mental health and crisis support
groups.description: Anything about health or crisis links out to official public health bodies or to qualified clinicians.

groups.title: Public rights and accommodation
groups.description: Content that touches on law stays general and points to official public information. It is not legal advice.

groups.title: Public safety and abuse support
groups.description: Safety content points you to trained local support. It does not build a safety plan around your situation.

groups.title: Public travel and pilgrimage rules
groups.description: Pilgrimage travel content links to official public information and says plainly that the rules change.

groups.title: Tools and data
groups.description: Every tool page names its data provider, shows how it works out the numbers, and says where those numbers can be off.

groups.title: Masjid and community
groups.description: Local details change, so check times and programs with the masjid directly.

groups.title: Zakat and financial education
groups.description: Money content stays educational. When the numbers are your own, have someone qualified check them.

groups.title: Resource publishers and organizations
groups.description: Every resource card names the organization, author, or publisher behind the recommendation.

policyNotes.title: What counts as a Quran translation?
policyNotes.body: When you read Quran in English on this site, you are reading a translation of the meaning rather than the Quran itself. Arabic text comes from a verified Quran text source.

policyNotes.title: How hadith citations are shown
policyNotes.body: Where guidance rests on a hadith, you should see the collection name, the number, a link, and the grading whenever that information exists.

policyNotes.title: When to ask a local imam
policyNotes.body: Personal fiqh questions, family complications, marriage, money, anything sensitive: use this site as a starting point and take the real question to a qualified local imam or scholar.

policyNotes.title: When to seek professional help
policyNotes.body: The mental health pages are here to explain things and to remind you that you are not the first person to feel this way. If you are in crisis, or the question is medical, legal, or financial, you need a qualified professional.
